candidate.answerReason: Equal prices make the total cost three times the cost of one third of the CDs. She spends 3/5 of her money and has 2/5 left.

methods.label: Three equal groups
methods.explanation:
Divide the CDs into three groups containing equal numbers of CDs. Because every CD has the same price, the groups have equal costs. One group costs \(\frac15\) of Brianna's money, so all three groups cost
\[
3\cdot\frac15=\frac35
\]
of her money. The fraction left is therefore
\[
1-\frac35=\boxed{\frac25},
\]
which is choice \(\mathrm{C}\).
methods.levelReason: Equal groups and elementary fraction arithmetic give a complete solution without algebra.
